security.title: Our Core
security.desc:
Supporting Every Stage of the HCIS / SAIS Security Project Lifecycle
Whether developing a new facility or upgrading an existing asset, security requirements evolve throughout the project lifecycle. VISO provides specialist security engineering consultancy from project initiation through operational readiness, ensuring security objectives, engineering deliverables, and regulatory requirements remain aligned at every stage.

s1.title: Security Risk Assessment (SRA)
s1.subtitle: Establish the security foundation.
s1.desc: The Security Risk Assessment (SRA) establishes the security foundation for the project by identifying critical assets, evaluating credible threats, assessing vulnerabilities, and determining the level of protection required for the facility. The assessment is conducted in accordance with applicable SAIS requirements and recognized international risk assessment methodologies, including ANSI/API 780 and ANSI/ASIS/RIMS RA.1-2015. The outcomes form the basis for the security engineering strategy, Concept of Design (CoD), and subsequent design stages.

s2.title: Preliminary design
s2.subtitle: Develop the engineering package.
s2.desc: Following completion of the Stage-1, we develop the security engineering package required to support project execution and regulatory submissions.

s3.title: Detailed Design Review & Project Delivery
s3.subtitle: Independent technical support.
s3.desc: During project execution, we provide independent technical support to help clients maintain engineering quality, regulatory compliance, and project performance.

s4.title: Operational Readiness & Project Close-Out
s4.subtitle: Verify, test, and integrate.
s4.desc: The final stage focuses on verifying that installed security systems are fully integrated, tested, documented, and ready for operation.
